name: Advanced EXIF Tools
description: Batch and single file renaming with a token system (sequence numbers, letters, capture date, camera and EXIF fields) plus an advanced metadata inspector and editor (creator, copyright, caption, keywords, capture time, GPS, and IPTC fields such as headline, credit, rights and location) with templates and per-photo variables, written in place for JPEG/TIFF and to XMP sidecars for RAW, and embedded as XMP and IPTC-IIM in exported JPEGs.
author: Anthony Reimche <anthonyreimche@gmail.com>
